[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Andros Hareel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] medical [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was assigned to investigate the plagues that were reportedly sweeping over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]]. Although all signs pointed to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] involvement in the plague's release to pacify the rebellious population, Dr. Hareel advised that an Alliance team be sent to Sedesia in hopes of destroying the plague.
